rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
rules.description: Writing user input directly to a web page allows for a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

rules.cwe_name: Sensitive Cookie Without 'HttpOnly' Flag
rules.description: Cookies without the `HttpOnly` attribute set can be accessed by JS scripts, making them more vulnerable to XSS attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection')
rules.description: Using user-controlled data to create a template can lead to remote code execution or cross site scripting.

rules.cwe_name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
rules.description: Deserializing user-controlled data may allow attackers to execute arbitrary code.

rules.cwe_name: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
rules.description: Using version v1 of Azure Storage client-side encryption is insecure, and may enable an attacker to decrypt encrypted data

rules.cwe_name: Improper Handling of Highly Compressed Data (Data Amplification)
rules.description: Uncontrolled data that flows into decompression library APIs without checking the compression rate is dangerous

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code ('Eval Injection')
rules.description: Interpreting unsanitized user input as code allows a malicious user to perform arbitrary code execution.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
rules.description: Passing user supplied arguments to a Javascript to Python translation engine such as Js2Py can lead to remote code execution.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic
rules.description: Building a NoSQL query from user-controlled sources is vulnerable to insertion of malicious NoSQL code by the user.
